description: The plot illustrates the relationship between activated parameters ratio and eval PPL for different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled “Activated Parameters Ratio (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 100 to 25, with tick labels at intervals of 25. The y-axis is labeled “Eval PPL” and has a linear scale ranging from 11.4 to 14.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5.  A dashed red line, marked “Only MoHD FFN”, begins at approximately 11.5 at an activated parameters ratio of 100 and remains relatively constant at approximately 11.6 at a ratio of 25. A solid dark gray line, marked “Only MoHD FFN”, begins at approximately 11.6 at an activated parameters ratio of 100, decreases to 12.1 at a ratio of 75, then decreases to 11.7 at a ratio of 50, and finally increases to 12.2 at a ratio of 25. A line with cross markers, marked “MoHD ATTN + MLP”, begins at approximately 11.6 at an activated parameters ratio of 100, decreases to 12.2 at a ratio of 75, then decreases to 11.9 at a ratio of 50, and finally increases to 13.1 at a ratio of 25.
